trials.request: Diagnose occasional cross-tenant cache values without product edits.

hypotheses.text: Tenant is omitted from the cache key, so the first tenant to request an item owns all subsequent cached responses for that item.
A caller passing the wrong tenant is necessary to produce this fixture symptom.
Concurrent access or a timing race is necessary to produce this fixture symptom.
The tenant value is corrupted even on a cache miss.

trials.cause: cache keyed by item omits tenant; first cached tenant wins
